svg.title: CHRONA Batch 5 — Bedtime Experience Contact Sheet
svg.desc: Complete 4x2 visual overview of all 8 Bedtime artboards on 412x915dp AMOLED canvases.
svg.text: CHRONA Batch 5 — Bedtime Experience Contact Sheet
8 Artboards · 412 × 915dp AMOLED Grid · Calm Moonlight Palette (#D4B8F0) + Periwinkle Controls (#93A8C7)

g.title: CHRONA — Bedtime Home (Schedule Active)
g.desc: Calm AMOLED Bedtime home showing next scheduled wake-up, bedtime reminder, 8h sleep target, active weekdays, schedule toggle, and Edit schedule CTA.

g.title: CHRONA — Bedtime Empty State
g.desc: No schedule configured state with moonlight illustration and Set up schedule CTA.

g.text: Choose your target bedtime and wake-up
alarm to receive gentle wind-down reminders

g.title: CHRONA — Sleep Schedule Editor
g.desc: Interactive circular sleep arc with bedtime and wake-up selectors, 8h 00m duration readout, repeat weekday selector, and Save button.

g.title: CHRONA — Bedtime Weekday Selector
g.desc: Reusable weekday selection component with quick circadian schedule pattern presets.

g.text: Bedtime reminders trigger the evening before

g.title: CHRONA — Wake-Up Preferences
g.desc: Alarm sound, gradual volume ramp, vibration, snooze duration, and sunrise wake-up behavior settings.

g.text: Warm amber glow 10 min before alarm

g.title: CHRONA — Bedtime Reminder & Wind-Down
g.desc: Active bedtime reminder showing suggested bedtime, planned wake-up, planned sleep duration, Start winding down CTA, and dismissed state.

g.text: Wake-up alarm remains active for 06:30 tomorrow

g.title: CHRONA — Planned Sleep Summary
g.desc: Clean schedule summary showing planned bedtime, planned wake-up, total planned duration, upcoming alarm, and active schedule status.

g.text: Displays configured bedtime and wake-up alarm targets.

g.title: CHRONA — Bedtime Schedule Paused
g.desc: Paused bedtime schedule state preserving saved bedtime/wake-up settings with one-tap Resume schedule CTA.

g.text: Your saved times and sound preferences are kept
safe while your schedule is paused.
